mchog gling thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi sgo nas/lha srin dam bsgrag nyin gcig ma'i 'don zin nyung ngu ni/thugs sgrub phrin las kyi bzlas pa/sto

tei:div.tei:p: mchog gling thugs sgrub bar chad kun sel gyi sgo nas/ lha srin dam bsgrag nyin gcig ma'i 'don zin nyung ngu ni/ 1$0000270thugs sgrub phrin las kyi bzlas pa/ stong tshigs/ dzap khang bsdu ba rnams grub mtshams/ gro lod kyi bdag mdun dbyer med bskyed bzlas/ stong tshigs bar gtang*/ bka' nan rab brjid dbu nas 'byung ba'i khyad par 'phags pa'i bskyed bzlas/ khrus chog zla ba'i bdud rtsi khrus bum bskyed bzlas 'od zhu bcas kyis bsgrubs/ dam can spyi gtor gyi khongs su gtor bsngos bla ma yi dam sbyar/ gter gzhi/ phrin las kyi tshogs/ skong ba g.yu zhal ma sbyar nas/ bshags pa'i mthar/ (bsang bdud rtsi'i sprin phung la/ gser skyems rtsa gsum kun 'dus dang*/)1$0000220'dir bsang skyems ni/ dwags brgyud kam tshang pa min na thugs sgrub rang gzhung bsang brngan rgyas bsdus sam/ dgon yul so so'i chos brgyud dang gnas yul skabs bstun bya na 'thus par nges/mchan/ 1$0000270sde brgyad gser skyems sbyar ba mthar chags su gtang*/ gro lod gtor zlog gi gser skyems 'bul/ bka' nan rab brjid ltar/ bskul bas che bskyed/ khrus chog ltar sbyong ba/ srung 'khor bcas sbyar/ ri khrus sam snod bcud spyi khrus rkyang pa'i rjes/ nam mkha' med par sogs kyi bden tshig brjod/ bka' nan rab brjid ltar/ sde brgyad snying nas drang zhing bkug nas/ dam la bzhags pa'i rjes su/ sde brgyad spyi mdos ltar mdos byin gyis brlabs/ de'i 'og nas mdos bsngo tshang ma/ glud bsngo bcas gtang*/ bka' nan rab brjid ltar/ mdos bsdus/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid gzhir bzhengs sogs byin brlab dang*/ 'bul tshig bcas la grangs gsog /rig 'dzin rgyun gdangs kyis/ phrin las ltar chad tho lan gsum gyer/ zur lugs gto gdangs kyis/ nan tan bka' bsgo'i dam gzhag gyer mtshams/ gro lod gtor zlog gi bskul pa nas/

bsgral las cha tshang gtang ba'i zhal bstab sngags bcas kyi rjes/ bka' nan rab brjid ltar gyi sngags kyang sbyar/ phrin las ltar tshogs la rol zhing lhag ma bsngo/ gro lod kyi zlog pa grangs gsog skabs dang bstun/ dam spyi'i gtor 'bul dang rjes chog mthar dbyung*/ sde brgyad spyi mdos ltar zhi ba'i lugs kyi glud mdos gshegs shing sngags rol 'og tu tshar kha shas bzla/ sdang dgra cham 'beb lta bu'i rol chen brdung*/ gro lod gtor zlog mtha'i gtor ma'i ye shes pa nam mkhar btegs pa nas/ zor bskul rjes/ phrin las ltar chad tho gtang*/ gro lod ltar zor bskul sogs gtang*/ spros pa bsdu skabs/ zor tshugs skabs 'don dgos pa rnams dor bas 'thus/ zor rnams 'ben la brdeg /gtor chen gyi sngon nam chabs cig tu sde brgyad kyi zos lhag ling ro blugs pa'i zor gtor yang brdeg /gtor zor mer bsreg /gro lod gtor zlog mjug dang*/ phrin las gnyis bsdebs pas rjes rim rnams mthar dbyung ba sogs bya'o// zhes pa'ang mkha' khyab rdo rjes 'phral mkhor spel ba dge// /1$0000220 ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon med gsar bzhag yin pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
